# CANDIDATE: VIX_FILTERED_VWAP_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

In elevated VIX (>22), price reverts to VWAP after sharp moves; a pullback to VWAP with a bullish candle offers a mean‑reversion edge. The VIX filter isolates high‑fear regimes where reversion is stronger, and the two‑bar deviation requirement avoids whipsaws from minor noise.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: When VIX > 22 and price deviates >0.8*ATR above VWAP (close - VWAP > 0.8*ATR) over two consecutive bars, then a bar closes back below VWAP with a bullish body (close > open) and volume > average_volume, go long at close. Exit shape: Stop at the prior bar’s low (chart‑stop), target at VWAP + 0.5*ATR or 1.5R, optional runner trail. Regime hint: Only fire when VIX >22 and during mid‑day (11:00‑13:30) when mean‑reversion dominates; avoid first/last 30 min.
